column1: She's waiting out on the freeway near the 7th Avenue on ramp.
column2: 她在高速公路7號出口附近等著。

column1: You find a knife concealed in the man's briefs. Good work!
column2: 你在那男子的內褲裡發現一把刀。做得好！

column1: You remove your cuffs from the drunk.
column2: 你從醉漢身上摘下手銬。

column1: You'd better have him dump out his pockets first.
column2: 你最好先叫他把口袋倒空。

column1: Sir, please step over here and empty your pockets into this drawer.
column2: 先生，請走這邊來，把口袋裡的東西倒進這個抽屜。

column1: Thanks, Sonny. Hope the rest of your patrol is less exciting.
column2: 謝謝，Sonny。希望你剩下的巡邏勤務沒那麼驚險。

column1: Step over here, Sir. Now!
column2: 先生，這邊走。立刻！

column1: I want you to blow as hard as you can into this tube.
column2: 我要你盡力對著這個管子吹。

column1: According to this, your blood alcohol level is .15. That is well over the legal limit. I'll have to book you.
column2: 根據這個，你的血中酒精濃度是 .15。這已經大大超過法定上限。我得登錄你。

column1: Hellooo!... Earth to Sonny! You gonna give me this guy's belongings or what?
column2: 喂！...Sonny，醒一醒！你到底要不要把這傢伙的東西交給我？

column1: Well?..
column2: 怎樣？..

column1: Bonds! You know better than to bring a prisoner in here without checking your gun first. That'll cost you a $2.50 fine.
column2: Bonds！你應該知道帶犯人進來前要先交槍。這要罰你2.50元。

column1: Put it here in the drop and you can get it back after you finished with the prisoner.
column2: 放在這個投置口裡，你處理完犯人後就可以拿回來。

column1: You walk over, deposit your gun and grudgingly pay the $2.50 fine.
column2: 你走過去，放下槍，勉強付了2.50元的罰款。

column1: You mean to tell me you fished that outta this guy's shorts? You've got some guts, Bonds.
column2: 你是說你從這傢伙的短褲裡掏出那東西？你膽子真大，Bonds。

column1: Hey Sonny, you want to book this guy?
column2: 嘿，Sonny，你要登錄這傢伙嗎？

column1: Let's get this prisoner booked, Bonds.
column2: 我們把這個犯人登錄了吧，Bonds。

column1: Finish up and hand him over, Bonds.
column2: 處理完了就把他交過來，Bonds。

column1: I'm about ready for a break, Bonds. Let's hurry up and get this guy behind bars so I can eat my sandwich.
column2: Bonds，我快要休息了。我們快點把這傢伙關起來，這樣我好吃我的三明治。

column1: I said I just got a message that you're to assist an officer on the freeway, Bonds. ASAP.
column2: 我說我剛收到一條訊息，要你立刻去高速公路協助一名警員，Bonds。

column1: You gonna go get me some bodies to lock up, or what?
column2: 你是去替我抓幾個人關起來，還是怎樣？

column1: Go catch some criminals, Bonds. I'm getting lonely in here.
column2: 去抓些犯人吧，Bonds。我在這裡都快寂寞了。

column1: The booking officer can't help you unless you give him something to work with.
column2: 登錄官沒有東西就幫不了你。

column1: Officer Bonds! It's extremely tacky to point your gun at a fellow officer, even in jest!
column2: Bonds 警員！就算是開玩笑，用槍指著同事也很不得體！

column1: He already knows who you are! Geez!
column2: 他已經知道你是誰了！天哪！

column1: Ah, tell it to your mother.
column2: 哈，去跟你媽說吧。

column1: I bet you like the strip search best of all.
column2: 我打賭你最喜歡的是全身搜身。

column1: I hear a night stick is a cop's best friend.
column2: 我聽說警棍是警察最好的朋友。

column1: Just get on with it unless you want a puddle.
column2: 要不你會尿出一灘來，所以快去做吧。

column1: You're so close to handing him over to the jailer.   Surely you can hold your temper for another few minutes.
column2: 你距離把他交給獄卒只差一點了。你肯定可以再忍幾分鐘。

column1: You've already searched him - and you didn't enjoy it much the first time.
column2: 你已經搜過他了，而且第一次搜的時候你也沒那麼喜歡。

column1: How dry I am. How wet I'll be. If I don't find a place to p.....

column1: You're so close to handing him over to the jailer. Surely you can hold your temper for another few minutes.

column1: You've already removed his cuffs.
column2: 你已經解下他的手銬了。

column1: You take your gun, embarrassed that you didn't check it outside.
column2: 你拿起槍，為自己沒有在外面就檢查而感到尷尬。

column2: 你要在投置口裡放什麼？

column1: You'll have to take the cuffs off first.
column2: 你得先解下手銬。

column1: You don't have anything to put in the drop.
column2: 你沒有東西可以放在投置口裡。

column1: You put the suspect's knife into the drawer.
column2: 你把嫌犯的刀放進抽屜。

column1: You put the suspect's license into the drawer.
column2: 你把嫌犯的證件放進抽屜。

column1: Only prisoners are allowed through that door.
column2: 只有犯人可以通過那扇門。

column1: One test is enough.
column2: 一次檢測就夠了。

column1: You need to remove his cuffs first.
column2: 你得先解下他的手銬。

column1: There's no reason to test this guy. His problems run deeper than alcohol!
column2: 沒必要測這傢伙。他的問題不只是酒精！

column1: There's no one to test.
column2: 沒有人可以測。

column1: You need to turn the machine on first.
column2: 你得先開機。

column2: 你打開了氣相色譜儀。
